characters.description: A wiry itinerant trader accompanied by a notoriously stubborn old donkey. Boards at The Hearth on weekends, unlatching battered wooden trunks of rare spice seeds and distant curiosities.
characters.quote: My donkey may be foul-tempered and smell of ditchwater, but the wares strapped to his pack-frame would make capital nobles weep.
characters.schedule: Thursday - Saturday: Boards at The Hearth selling exotic goods; Sunday: Hits the road with his laden pack-donkey
characters.real_world_wound: Lost his merchant caravan and fortune during the wartime border raids; now scrapes by in his elderly years accompanied solely by an old donkey.
characters.heart_event_summary: 15% discount on exotic wares (2H); sells rare foreign spice seeds (4H); delivers rumors and news from beyond the mountain pass (6H); signs weekly wholesale supply contract for the homestead (8H).

sunny.activity: Feeds dry meadow hay to his stubborn old donkey and brushes its burrs
Flings open cedar trade trunks displaying foreign seeds and spices
Sips warm spiced cider and recounts stories of distant frontier passes

rainy.activity: Checks waterproof canvas wraps on dry goods and mends burlap bags
Dries boots by the fireplace, tallies spice seed packets, and plans travel routes

heart_events.title: The Stubborn Old Donkey
heart_events.description: His stubborn mule sits stubborn in the gateway; Rowan coaxes it with carrots and crusty bread.
heart_events.reward_unlock: 15% discount on all caravan inventory.

heart_events.title: The Nomad Trunk
heart_events.description: Unlocks strange trunks from Thursday to Saturday by the porch of The Hearth.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Stocks exclusive foreign spices and rare imported seed strains.

heart_events.title: Weekly Supply Charter
heart_events.description: Picks The Hearth as his permanent haven to rest his faithful mule in old age.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Weekly Delivery Charter automatically stocking exotic goods into estate larders.

characters.name: Hester
characters.role: Reclusive Former Knight & Armor Maintenance Specialist
characters.description: A cloaked, reclusive deserter hiding beneath a tattered cowl in the corner attic loft. Avoids strangers, yet possesses peerless mastery in restoring heavy military plate armor.
characters.quote: Never ask which crest I fought for. Beneath churned mud and spilled blood, every banner looks identical.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Secreted away in the attic loft mending armor; Midnight: Solitary walks beside the estate pond
characters.real_world_wound: Crushing survivor's guilt after witnessing comrades massacre non-combatants; deserted in horror, living with the constant paranoia of bounty hunters.
characters.heart_event_summary: Teaches armor reinforcement (+10 DEF) at 2 Hearts; restores weapon and armor durability against cracking at 4 Hearts; reconciles with former commander Valerius at 6 Hearts; bequeaths legendary Forsaken Knight's Blade at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Hammers gently on a miniature anvil, reshaping dented steel pauldrons
Gazes quietly through cracked cedar shakes toward distant jagged ridges
Walks through cool nighttime shadows savoring unbroken quiet

rainy.activity: Oils plate gauntlets and replaces rotted leather harness straps
Silently accepts a steaming bowl of stew from Rowan before returning to his room

heart_events.title: Midnight Anvil Clatter
heart_events.description: Huddled in the attic hammering armor plates late at night; Rowan brings roast steak to ease tension.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Reinforces coarse armor plating (+10 DEF) on worn gear.

heart_events.title: Restoring Gear Durability
heart_events.description: Offers field repairs on chipped swords and dented plates straight out of her attic room.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Affordable Field Durability Repair service for weapons and armor.

heart_events.title: Shadow of the Former Mentor
heart_events.description: Spots Valerius entering the tavern; panics and prepares to flee into the night over desertion guilt.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Royal Blade Whetstone Oil preventing rust.

heart_events.title: Casting Aside the Mask of Guilt
heart_events.description: Bows before Valerius seeking atonement, embraced and forgiven by her old captain.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Bestows Forsaken Royal Knight Broadsword (heavy combat weapon).

heart_events.title: No More Running
heart_events.description: Hester pulls down her travel cowl, offering a knightly amulet and pledging life beside Rowan.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Romantic Bond unlocked; Hester permanently pledges her blade to the estate.

characters.name: Mae
characters.role: Nomadic Weaver & Finished Home Furnishings Artisan
characters.description: A warm-hearted nomadic weaver wrapped in hand-spun scarlet wool, visiting Oakhaven during autumn and winter. Buys homestead fleeces and goat down at premium rates.
characters.quote: Biting frontier frost is nothing when you have a double-woven wool blanket and a roasted potato straight from the hearth.
characters.schedule: Fall & Winter: Knits beside The Hearth fireplace; Spring & Summer: Migrates across northern highland pastures
characters.real_world_wound: Her nomadic clan was scattered and separated during the border conflicts; journeys across wilderness valleys weaving wool while searching for kin.
characters.heart_event_summary: Buys raw wool and down at +30% price (2H); gifts automated Homestead Loom (4H); sells finished dyed bedding and quilts for bunkhouse rooms (6H); unlocks handcrafted upholstery and tapestries collection (8H).

sunny.activity: Hangs skeins of fresh wool steeped in berry and bark dyes to dry
Swiftly knits wool scarves and heavy winter cloaks for townspeople
Sips wildflower honey tea while listening to travelers discuss pass conditions

rainy.activity: Spins bobbins of raw fleece by the crackling flame
Folds thick, double-loomed woolen blankets into cedar storage chests

heart_events.title: Natural Maple Varnish
heart_events.description: Shares traditional recipes boiling maple resin into weatherproofing varnish for rough furniture.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Purchases farmstead raw fleece at +30% premium prices.

heart_events.title: Refurnishing the Guest Rooms
heart_events.description: Carpenters new pine bedframes and warm quilts for The Hearth's boarding lofts.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Sells Complete Rough Timber Furniture & Natural Painting Finishes packages.

heart_events.title: Nomad Clan Loom
heart_events.description: Presents Rowan with an heirloom spinning rig as a lasting token of nomad gratitude.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Automated Farmstead Weaving Loom & luxury wool quilts (+cozy rating).

characters.name: Old Gomer
characters.location: Surface Quarry & Mine Entrance Powder Magazine
characters.description: A stubborn dwarf living in a canvas lean-to at Floor 60 of the mines, his beard singed black by black powder. Deeply deaf from decades of underground blasts, he sells mining charges and points out unstable ore veins.
characters.quote: EH?! SPEAK UP, LAD! LOST ME EARS WHEN TUNNEL EIGHT CAVED IN THIRTY YEARS BACK! YOU NEED BLASTING POWDER OR WHAT?!
characters.schedule: Daytime: Packs gunpowder casings and sells charges at surface quarry camp; Occasionally: Inspects shallow blast sites; Night: Drinks moonshine by camp braziers
characters.real_world_wound: Deafened in a catastrophic shaft collapse and cast out of the miners' guild; clings to the deep shafts because explosions are the only sound he still feels in his chest.
characters.heart_event_summary: Sells discount Blasting Charges at the surface entrance (2H); teaches recipe for Mega Rock Blasting Bomb (4H); reveals hidden gold veins (6H); gifts handheld Steam Core Drill (8H).

sunny.activity: Crushes sulfur and hardwood charcoal into heavy copper casings
Fires blasting cord, shattering granite to breach rich ore pockets
Swigs potent moonshine straight from the bottle and tunes friction primers

rainy.activity: Dips blasting fuses in tallow wax to seal them against groundwater seepage
Taps rock walls with a ball-peen hammer listening for hollow hidden caverns

heart_events.title: Bellows of the Deaf Blaster
heart_events.description: Deafened by blasting powder, he shouts like thunder; Rowan converses via slate chalkboard.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Sells Craft Dynamite at discount rates for clearing rubble.

heart_events.title: Minehead Gas Pocket Survey
heart_events.description: Alerts Rowan to unstable fault fissures and noxious gas veins around upper shafts.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Sells Heavy Bore Explosives demolishing giant obstructive boulders.

heart_events.title: Compact Steam Rock Drill
heart_events.description: Finalizes a steam-powered mini rock drill engine, presenting it to Rowan.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Handheld Steam Drill (mines 3x3 ore clusters in cavern deeps).

characters.name: Vael
characters.description: A reticent diver in a vulcanized fish-skin drysuit, exploring high-pressure flooded shafts at Floor 90 to retrieve ancient artifacts and rare blind subterranean fauna.
characters.quote: A thousand fathoms below the mountain, there is no dawn. Only absolute stillness... and bioluminescent eyes staring back through the black.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Camps by the surface glacial lake sorting lichen; Occasionally: Dives subterranean fissures; Night: Salt-cures fish and repairs diving valves
characters.real_world_wound: Watched his entire salvage crew swallowed by an abyssal trench creature; withdrawn and gripped by the dread of deep water, yet unable to abandon it.
characters.heart_event_summary: Sells Anti-Slip Deep Diving Boots (2H); teaches Luminous Abyss Bait recipe (4H); sells Miasma-Resistant Glow Pearls (6H); opens submerged diving link between mountain lake and river (8H).

sunny.activity: Calibrates air bladder valves on his deep-sea diving helmet
Dives into ink-black depths dredging gem geodes and fossilized nautiloids
Hangs glowing blind cavefish on salt-curing drying lines

rainy.activity: Patches air-hose seals with tree sap and copper wire
Monitors surging groundwater surges feeding from highland storm drainage

heart_events.title: Frostbitten Ankles at the Lake
heart_events.description: Shivering by mountain tarn campfires with numb feet, he is treated to hot spirits and woolen socks.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Sells Fishskin Boots with anti-slip traction on frozen floors.

heart_events.title: Subterranean Aquifer Fissures
heart_events.description: Surveys underwater cave tunnels linking the mountain tarn into flooded mine grottoes.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Opens submerged diving shortcut from mountain lake into Oakhaven's outer rivers.

heart_events.title: Conquering the Abyssal Ghost
heart_events.description: Overcomes survivor guilt after losing his dive team, gifting reinforced diving apparatus.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Reinforced Steam Diving Suit (permits crossing deep waters in sunken caverns).

characters.name: Rowena
characters.description: An old woods-woman living alone in a smoke-wreathed woodland shanty, soot permanently ground into her weathered face. Produces dense heartwood charcoal that burns three times longer than standard coal.
characters.quote: Town brats call me a soot-hag, but without my kilns their fingers would turn blue before the first hard freeze.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Stacks timber mounds and tends slow-smoldering clay kilns; Evening: Roasts roots beside her kiln shanty
characters.real_world_wound: Lost her husband and son in the frontier garrison defense; retreated into dense woods to find solace in hearth-smoke away from painful memories.
characters.heart_event_summary: Supplies x3 Duration Heartwood Charcoal (2H); teaches Smokeless Earthen Kiln design (4H); -20% coal required for smelting ingots (6H); unlocks Master Ash-Retort Smelting Furnace (8H).

sunny.activity: Chops dried pine rounds, stacking them into conical earthen kiln mounds
Packs river clay over kiln vents, regulating slow smoldering airflow
Unpacks glistening jet-black lump charcoal into coarse burlap sacks

rainy.activity: Lashes heavy waxed canvas over charcoal stores against autumn downpours
Pulls ash-roasted potatoes from the coals and sips cool well water

heart_events.title: Eye-Stinging Charcoal Smoke
heart_events.description: Blinded by thick kiln soot, her stinging eyes are flushed with sterile herb water by Rowan.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Rowan 10 seasoned kiln-fired oak charcoal lumps.

heart_events.title: Fueling The Hearth's Ovens
heart_events.description: Contracts high-heat charcoal supplies for the tavern bakery and village smithy.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Sells Dense Kiln Charcoal (burns 3x longer in bakery ovens and forge smelters).

heart_events.title: Stepping Out of the Soot Shack
heart_events.description: Healing from the grief of losing husband and son in war, she visits the tavern for communal suppers.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Shares Advanced Smokeless Husk Kiln blueprints with the farmstead.

characters.name: Old Tad
characters.description: A toothless, sun-baked marsh dweller living aboard a mossy, flat-bottomed skiff, smelling perpetually of bog-mud and catfish. Master of weaving bamboo fish-baskets and setting passive weir traps.
characters.quote: An eel possesses sharper wit than half the town. If you want him in your basket, your patience had better outlast the silt.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Weaves bamboo traps and wades reed-beds checking eel pots; Night: Casts drift nets across marsh waters
characters.real_world_wound: His lowland home was ruined when downstream floodgates were blown during the retreat; now drifts solo across forgotten swamp shallows.
characters.heart_event_summary: Gifts Automated Bamboo Weir Trap (2H); teaches Marsh Bait Dough recipe (4H); reveals prime marsh holes for Golden Eels (6H); gifts Thousand-Year Bamboo Rod (+25% fishing bite speed) (8H).

sunny.activity: Splits green river cane with a curved knife to weave eel cylinders
Wades waist-deep placing baited tube traps into cattail roots
Puffs a pipe of cured wild marshleaf and takes a pull of strong cider

rainy.activity: Mends woven throw-nets for high-water catfish runs
Hauls wriggling baskets of fat channel catfish from the weir

heart_events.title: The Leaking Skiff
heart_events.description: His reed skiff springs a leak; Rowan wades through muck to haul it ashore and seal it with pine pitch.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts a tin of marsh mudworms for catfish angling.

heart_events.title: Marshland Fish Traps
heart_events.description: Instructs Rowan in weaving bamboo funnel pots to trap eels along slow marsh creeks.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Crafting formula for Automated Bamboo Fish & Eel Traps.

heart_events.title: Revival of the Reeds
heart_events.description: Beholding the cleansed marshlands, he beams toothlessly and yields his heirloom cane rod.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Bestows Ancestral Thousand-Year Bamboo Rod (+25% bite and reel velocity).

characters.name: Milo
characters.description: The rowdiest scamp in Oakhaven, constantly spotted balancing atop orchard stone walls eyeing Rowan's ripe apples and strawberries. If befriended with warm treats, he becomes a nimble woodland scout for hidden forage.
characters.quote: I swear on my slingshot I only climbed that apple branch to rescue a lost moth! Give me a chunk of that hot crusty loaf and I'll show you where the truffles grow!
characters.schedule: Morning: Escapes Clara's lessons at the library; Afternoon: Scopes out fruit orchard fence lines; Evening: Slingshot pebble contests with friends
characters.real_world_wound: His parents are exhausted struggling to rebuild their livelihoods after the war, leaving him largely unattended; acts out to feel seen and valued by adults.
characters.heart_event_summary: Stops stealing fruit and gathers windfalls for Rowan (2H); marks secret forest berry groves on your map (4H); delivers rare wild honeycomb (6H); organizes the Junior Scout Watch warning of wild boars (8H).

sunny.activity: Fidgets with smooth river pebbles and folds parchment gliders
Hides in hazel bushes scouting sun-blushed apples
Shoots acorn targets with a wooden slingshot alongside local kids

rainy.activity: Diverts roof rain puddles with sticks into miniature mud canals
Lingers inhaling cinnamon bun aromas hoping for day-old crusts

heart_events.title: Dangling on the Paling Fence
heart_events.description: Caught stealing strawberries, dangling upside down by torn trousers; Rowan unhooks and mends them.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts Rowan 5 wild forest berry seeds.

heart_events.title: Secret Berry Thickets
heart_events.description: Leads Rowan to concealed wild hives and cliffside raspberry thickets.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Automatically gathers fallen orchard fruit 2 days a week.

heart_events.title: Junior Forest Scouts
heart_events.description: Proudly pinned as Junior Scout, keeping mischievous eyes peeled for wild farm invaders.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Junior Scout Network alerts player 1 day in advance of wild beast crop incursions.

characters.name: Little Cora
characters.description: A shy, soft-spoken little girl whose father never returned from the front lines. Spends quiet hours collecting polished pebbles to thread onto cords, expertly grinding colored minerals into brilliant natural fence paint.
characters.quote: Every stone in the creek has its own quiet color. I keep the prettiest ones tucked in my basket for when Father walks up the lane...
characters.schedule: Morning: Forages polished pebbles along stream gravel bars; Afternoon: Strings cord necklaces on the library porch; Evening: Helps her mother cook
characters.real_world_wound: Grieving a father declared missing in action; clings to the quiet childish belief that stringing a thousand colored pebbles will guide him safely home.
characters.heart_event_summary: Gifts Lucky Pebble Bracelet (+5% dodge) (2H); marks secret stream berry patches and gudgeon holes (4H); helps gather windfalls along stream banks (6H); joyful reunion when her father returns safely to The Hearth (8H).

sunny.activity: Wades the shallows gathering gleaming banded quartz pebbles into her woven basket
Carefully threads drilled river stones onto waxed hemp cords
Helps her mother stir wild root broth and tucks her stone basket under her pillow

rainy.activity: Grinds chalky mineral shale in a stone mortar into bright paint pigments
Paints a chimney-smoke cabin onto a split cedar shingle

heart_events.title: A Thousand Stones for Father
heart_events.description: Gathers freezing river pebbles in jars waiting for her soldier father; Rowan warms her hands with a scarf.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Gifts River Pebble Bracelet (+5% Dodge Chance in combat).

heart_events.title: The Clear Brook Goby Eddy
heart_events.description: Shows Rowan a crystal eddy beneath river willows teaming with darting sweetfish.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Unlocks Secret Brook Angling Spot rich in rare freshwater fish.

heart_events.title: The Letter of Safe Return
heart_events.description: Receives word her father has been discharged safely; they reunite in tearful joy beside The Hearth.
heart_events.reward_unlock: Cora bestows the family's lucky River Jade talisman.
